name: Mivelsiran
sort_evidence: Alnylam's 10-Q filed 2026-07-30 lists mivelsiran (formerly ALN-APP), an RNAi therapeutic targeting APP, in CAA and Alzheimer's disease, with Phase 2 NCT07636811 recruiting and no approval.

trials.title: A Study to Evaluate Mivelsiran in Adult Participants With Early-Stage Down Syndrome-Associated Alzheimer's Disease (DS-AD)
